headline: Eyüpspor have not scored in five games; Kasımpaşa visit
summary: Eyüpspor have lost their last five Süper Lig games without scoring — 0-19 across that run — and sit 18th of 18 with a goal difference of -20. Kasımpaşa arrive seventh on 13 points after a 4-1 home win over Samsunspor, beaten once in eight league games, and they have won three of the last four meetings. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Kasımpaşa are 60.6% favourites, almost four times Eyüpspor's chance. Yet the goals market stays low: Eyüpspor get a head start of 0.92 goals, and over 2.5 goals is only 47%.
read: Bottom-of-the-table Eyüpspor have lost five straight league games without scoring, conceding 19, and now host a Kasımpaşa side sitting seventh with one defeat in eight. The market makes Kasımpaşa clear 60.6% favourites, rated about a goal the better, with the goals line leaning just under 2.5.
